debate.key_bear_argument: Intermediate and long-term structure is decisively bearish (price below EMA-50, SMA-200, and Ichimoku cloud), macro environment is hostile (VIX crisis, FOMC in 2 days, earnings in 9 days), fundamental conviction is absent, and weak ADX (19.93) negates trend strength—overbought oscillators in a downtrend are exhaustion signals, not entry triggers.
